title: Projects that leave a mark
subtitle: A selection of sites, stages and coaching engagements — built for rigor and presence.

promise.label: Promise
promise.quote: Projects delivered with clarity — from site to stage.

detail.ctaText: Let’s talk about your need — you’ll get a clear proposal back.

pont-cotonou.title: Urban crossing structure
pont-cotonou.summary: Technical support on a major urban bridge project.
pont-cotonou.overview: On a strategic corridor in a dense area, the structure had to ease traffic while respecting soil constraints, phasing and continuity of use. The goal: secure technical choices, document controls and keep coordination with the design team sharp.
pont-cotonou.context: High-impact urban infrastructure: crossing in a dense setting, multiple interfaces (roads, utilities, residents) and a tight schedule. Structural specs and control traceability were critical for handover.
pont-cotonou.role: Consulting engineer — technical follow-up, note review, site checkpoints and coordination with the design team to resolve gaps before they cost time.
pont-cotonou.result: Delivery to specification, on schedule, with a clear control file for the owner. Non-conformities were handled early rather than at the end of the works.
approach: Frame technical requirements and control points
Regular reviews of drawings and execution notes

complexe-residential.title: Residential complex
complexe-residential.summary: Construction supervision for a multi-building housing program.
complexe-residential.overview: Multi-building program with soil constraints and tight phasing. The aim was to secure structural quality while keeping dialogue fluid between developer, contractors and the design office.
complexe-residential.context: Residential scheme across several lots, with many technical interfaces and strong pressure on first-building delivery dates.
complexe-residential.role: Technical supervision and contractor interface — validating execution, quality alerts and support for developer arbitrations.
complexe-residential.result: Structural quality validated, fewer non-conformities on site, and clearer reporting for technical and financial follow-up.
approach: Phase reviews before moving to the next lot

voirie-porto.title: Road rehabilitation
voirie-porto.summary: Technical assistance on an urban roadway project.
voirie-porto.overview: Rehabilitation of pavements and associated networks in an urban setting. The project required rigorous quality control and clear reporting for a non-technical owner.
voirie-porto.context: Works in an urban area with traffic constraints, utility coordination and surface durability requirements.
voirie-porto.role: Quality control and reporting for the owner — field presence, execution checks and gap summaries.
voirie-porto.result: Improved surface durability, clearer deliverables, and better-informed decisions throughout the works.

emission-prime.title: Prime-time show
emission-prime.summary: Hosting a cultural show with strong audience performance.
emission-prime.overview: Weekly format mixing debates, portraits and live moments. On-air hosting had to stay fluid, embodied and true to the show’s brand tone.
emission-prime.context: Cultural prime time with varied guests, timed segments and an audience used to a precise rhythm.
emission-prime.role: Lead presenter — on-air flow, interviews and live transitions.
emission-prime.result: Loyal audience, strong show branding, and positive feedback on presence and clarity of exchanges.
approach: Live hosting with listening and pace
Debrief to refine the next episode

gala-national.title: National gala
gala-national.summary: Master of ceremonies for an awards evening.
gala-national.overview: Protocol ceremony bringing institutions and private partners together. The stake: an impeccable run of show, the right tone and frictionless timing.
gala-national.context: Awards evening with protocol, multiple speeches, prize moments and capture constraints.
gala-national.role: Master of ceremonies — run-of-show writing, transitions, announcements and room pace.
gala-national.result: Smooth evening, right tone, unanimous organizer feedback and capture without rhythm breaks.

conference-ceo.title: Executive summit
conference-ceo.summary: Moderation of a full day of executive conferences.
conference-ceo.overview: A day of panels, keynotes and networking for executives. Moderation had to energize exchanges without overshadowing speakers, while holding a tight schedule.
conference-ceo.context: Multi-session forum with sponsors, international speakers and a demanding audience.
conference-ceo.role: Moderator and master of ceremonies for the day — opening, panels, transitions and close.
conference-ceo.result: Dynamic exchanges, timing respected, sponsor and participant satisfaction.
approach: Align on the forum’s key messages

atelier-executives.title: Executive workshop
atelier-executives.summary: Intensive public speaking program for a leadership team.
atelier-executives.overview: Leaders needed to align strategic messaging with presence. The program combined method, individual feedback and near-real drills.
atelier-executives.context: Executive team exposed internally and externally, with uneven comfort levels when speaking.
atelier-executives.role: Coach — curriculum design, group sessions and targeted one-to-one feedback.
atelier-executives.result: Measurable gains in clarity, posture and public-meeting impact; a shared language to carry strategy.
approach: Work on voice, posture and stage fright

masterclass-youth.title: Youth masterclass
masterclass-youth.overview: Group training for young talent stepping onto stage or media. Focus: method, confidence and intensive live drills.
masterclass-youth.context: Motivated but uneven cohort — need for a demanding and supportive frame.
masterclass-youth.role: Lead trainer — method, exercises, feedback and preparation for public appearances.
masterclass-youth.result: More confident cohort; several participants placed in hosting or public speaking roles.

coaching-politique.title: High-stakes speech prep
coaching-politique.summary: Targeted coaching for a high-exposure public address.
coaching-politique.overview: Public intervention under strong media attention. Coaching covered the script, rehearsals and stress management for clear, credible presence.
coaching-politique.context: High-stakes address, mixed audience and expected press coverage.
coaching-politique.role: Coach — speech structure, rehearsals, posture and stage-fright management.
coaching-politique.result: Clear speech, steady posture, positive press coverage and control of the core message.
approach: Clarify the goal and single core message
